name: Odinokij "Sovjonok"
source:
What happens if your deepest dream comes true? If something you've been dreaming about for a long time happens. And what will you feel when you realize that it would have been better if your dream never came true?

A year has passed since Semyon miraculously found himself in the "Sovenok" camp. He dreams of returning there. And one fine day, it happens. But what happens next shocks Semyon, which makes him want to get away from this camp and never return...
translation:
如果你最深的梦想成真会发生什么？如果你长久以来梦想的事情发生了。当你意识到如果你的梦想从未实现会更好，你会有什么感受？

谢苗奇迹般地加入“索维诺克”阵营已经过去一年了。他梦想着回到那里。有一天，事情发生了。但接下来发生的事情让谢苗震惊，这让他想要离开这个营地，再也不要回来……
